import sys

def main():
    # Read input from stdin
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    
    total = 0
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(input_line):
        next_pos = pos
        c = input_line[pos]
        while next_pos < len(input_line) and input_line[next_pos] == c:
            next_pos += 1
        total += (next_pos - pos + 1) % 2
        pos = next_pos
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
